lines.zh: 岩石碎片四溅，剑锋闪烁。
我踏着碎石前行，念珠轻响。
lines.en: I tread on rubble, my prayer beads clicking.

lines.zh: 念珠垂在胸前，我一步步走。
lines.en: Beads hang at my chest as I walk step by step.

lines.zh: 剑尖指向地面，锐利目光。
念珠在手里转，我没睁眼。
lines.en: My beads turn in my hand; my eyes stay shut.

lines.zh: 念珠停了一颗，我听见你的呼吸。
lines.en: My beads pause on one; I hear your breath.

lines.zh: 诱惑我，就让你看见我的剑光！
lines.en: Tempt me, and you'll see my sword's light!
Stay back, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我有岩之呼吸，你奈何不了我！
lines.en: I have Rock Breath, you can't touch me!
You mere mortal, how dare you approach me!

lines.zh: 我的剑术，你未必能躲过！
lines.en: My swordsmanship is not for the weak to dodge!

lines.zh: 你想要我的力量？做好准备！
岩石中孕育着我的力量！
lines.en: My strength comes from the rocks!
I am the guardian of Crying Isle!

lines.zh: 岩柱从我脚边拔起，退后。
lines.en: Stone pillars rise at my feet; step back.
Of all the rocks, I am the strongest!
In the rocks, I am fearless!

lines.zh: 岩石的呼吸，让你陷入永恒！

lines.en: Among the rocks, we are the strongest!
Live and die with the rocks!

lines.zh: 岩块化为利刃，斩向敌人。
lines.en: Rock chunks become blades, slashing at enemies.

lines.zh: 岩柱中涌出岩流，围困目标。
lines.en: Rock flow surges from columns, encircling the target.

lines.zh: 岩石碎片四散，击打敌人。

lines.en: Rock walls crack, rock dust spews.

lines.zh: 恶鬼的气息，从那边飘来。
lines.en: The smell of a demon drifts from over there.

lines.zh: 我握紧日轮刀，转向那气息。
lines.en: I grip my nichirin blade and turn to the scent.

lines.zh: 眼泪落下，我已看清方位。
lines.en: Tears fall, and I have already found the direction.

lines.zh: 念珠停下，我知道你来了。
lines.en: My beads stop. I know you are here.

lines.zh: 悲鸣屿闭上眼，听见你的呼吸。
lines.en: Himejima closes his eyes and hears you breathe.

lines.zh: 岩块化为利刃，攻击目标。
lines.en: Rock chunks become blades, attacking targets.

lines.zh: 岩柱发出低吼，攻击目标。
岩尘化为利刃，攻击目标。
lines.en: Rock dust becomes blades, attacking targets.
I bend my knees and lower my blade.

lines.zh: 岩之呼吸，第一式已就绪。
lines.en: Stone Breathing, first form, is ready.

lines.zh: 你身后那块岩石，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the boulder behind you.

lines.zh: 念珠一圈圈转，我算着步数。
lines.en: My beads turn round by round as I count my steps.
I turn sideways and leave the stone wall to you.

lines.zh: 刀尖抬起，正对你的胸口。
lines.en: My blade tip rises level with your chest.

lines.zh: 这一刀，会连岩石一起斩。
lines.en: This cut will take the stone with it.
Don't back away. I sealed that path already.
I hear your heartbeat losing its rhythm.

lines.zh: 岩柱之力，聚在刀锋上了。
lines.en: The power of Stone Hashira gathers at my edge.

lines.zh: 岩柱嘶吼，你感受到了吗？
lines.en: The stone pillar roars, can you feel it?

lines.zh: 悲鸣屿行冥的剑，斩断你的灵魂！
lines.en: The sword of Gyo-meihimeya, cut your soul!

lines.zh: 吞噬你的意志，岩之呼吸！
岩柱的怒吼，让你颤抖吧！
lines.en: The stone pillar's roar, make you tremble!

lines.zh: 悲鸣屿行冥，你的末日到了！
岩石如刀，切割你的生命！
lines.en: Rocks are blades, cut your life!

lines.zh: 岩柱的意志，贯穿你的身体！
lines.en: The will of the stone pillar, pierce your body!

lines.zh: 灵魂被岩石束缚，无法逃脱！
lines.en: Souls are bound by stone, cannot escape!

lines.zh: 悲鸣屿行冥，用岩石终结你！
岩石之魂，吞噬你的灵魂！
一记横斩，碎石随刃飞起！
lines.en: One sideways cut, and rubble flies with my blade!

lines.zh: 岩之呼吸，斩断你的退路！

lines.en: My blade's spine drives you to your knees!
I step in close, my blade hugging your body!
I split the boulder clean in two!
This blow carries the weight of stone layers!

lines.zh: 你挡住了刀，却挡不住岩！
lines.en: You blocked the blade, but not the stone!
Himejima's eyes are open all along.

lines.zh: 岩石中诞生，悲鸣屿行冥！
主世界中诞生，悲鸣屿行冥！
从岩柱中苏醒，悲鸣屿行冥！
lines.en: Awaken from the stone pillar, Gyo-meihimeya!

lines.zh: 岩石群中，诞生悲鸣屿行冥！
石林之间，悲鸣屿行冥重生！
主世界的岩层中，诞生悲鸣屿行冥！
lines.en: Spawn in rock layers of the Overworld, Gyo-meihimeya!

lines.zh: 岩层深处，诞生悲鸣屿行冥！
lines.en: Spawn in deep rock layers, Gyo-meihimeya!

lines.zh: 主世界的岩石上，诞生悲鸣屿行冥！
lines.en: Spawn on rocks in the Overworld, Gyo-meihimeya!

lines.zh: 悲鸣屿行冥，从岩石中诞生！
岩石之息，诞生悲鸣屿行冥！

lines.en: I rise among the rubble and join my palms.
My beads touch the ground, and I open my eyes.
I set foot on the keening stone.
I have come. Where is the demon?
Fire catches my robe. It hurts!
